note: Hand-written summaries of clauses chosen from data/processed/bylaw_candidates.json. Each entry lists the PDF page(s) and a short verbatim quote; data/build_bylaws_summary.py fails if any quote is not found on its page. City-wide bylaws, not Koramangala-specific.

evidence.quote: under section. 3 of the Karnataka Slum Areas (Improvement & Clearance) Act, 1973

clauses.summary: Any development in an area notified under Section 3 of the Karnataka Slum Areas (Improvement & Clearance) Act, 1973 requires a No-Objection Certificate from the Karnataka Slum Clearance and Improvement Board, confirming non-interference with existing improvement schemes.

evidence.quote: housing schemes for EWS, LIG, Slum Clearance and Improvement Schemes

clauses.summary: Minimum plot size (50 sqm) and width (6m) rules for residential buildings can be relaxed by the Authority for EWS (Economically Weaker Section), LIG (Low Income Group) housing schemes, slum clearance/improvement schemes, and reconstruction in densely populated areas.

evidence.quote: shall have sanction for their sub-divisions under section 17 of the Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961
permission from the Bangalore Development Authority (a) for the change of land use

clauses.summary: Sites outside approved BDA layouts need sanction for sub-division under the Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961, from the Bangalore Development Authority. Land use changes not conforming to the development plan/zoning also require BDA permission.

evidence.quote: The set backs required on all the sides of building/s, maximum plot coverage, maximum FAR

clauses.summary: Buildings must maintain minimum front/side/rear setbacks (Tables 4-5) and comply with plot coverage and Floor Area Ratio (FAR) limits (Table 6) that vary by plot size and road width. Higher-value redevelopment (larger footprint, more floors) is setback- and FAR-constrained the same way regardless of the plot owner's income level.

relevance_for_personas.poor: EWS/LIG relaxation (7.2) and slum-clearance NOC (3.2(10.7)) are directly relevant if any planning scenario touches informal settlements like the Koramangala Slum flood-prone point.
relevance_for_personas.middle: Setback/FAR rules (9.2, Tables 4-6) most relevant for any redevelopment of existing 1-2BHK apartment stock.
relevance_for_personas.wealthy: Land-use change rules (7.3) most relevant for bungalow-to-commercial conversions or larger redevelopment proposals, common in older Koramangala blocks.
